_note: An example config for the serving template (packs/serving): Qwen3-14B-FP8 on vLLM at TP1, random 1024/1024 at C64, standalone. Copy it and set the <...> values for your node. In component mode a host (Hyperloom's Arbor adapter) writes the same keys plus mode, docker_container @host and the component block (docs/hosts.md). Checks without a GPU: python3 -m arbor run --config configs/serving-template.json --dry-run.
goal: Raise Qwen3-14B-FP8's output throughput per GPU at C64 (random 1024 in / 1024 out) on one GPU, without losing p90 interactivity.
_gsm8k_note: Set GSM8K_MIN in server_env to the model's reference score on the full set less about three standard errors of the subset; until then the correctness check applies a 0.30 sanity floor.
